_note: Town pages (/architects/<slug>/, /es/arquitectos/<slug>/). Hand-kept: name, the geocoding query, the canton only where OpenStreetMap leaves it out, region, whether the town is on the coast (the maritime zone law applies), and a short local note only where it is a fact we can stand behind. Everything else (coordinates, canton, elevation, rain, temperature, wind, roads) comes from scripts/towns-fetch.mjs and scripts/towns-rain.py into data/town-data.json. To add a town: add it here, run both scripts, then node scripts/build.mjs.

note.en: The beach belongs to Las Baulas National Marine Park, where leatherback turtles nest. Lights that can be seen from the sand are restricted, so exterior lighting is part of the design from the start.
note.es: La playa es parte del Parque Nacional Marino Las Baulas, donde anida la tortuga baula. Las luces que se ven desde la arena están restringidas, así que la iluminación exterior entra en el diseño desde el principio.

note.en: The coast in front of Uvita is Marino Ballena National Park, so lots along the beach border a protected area.
note.es: La costa frente a Uvita es el Parque Nacional Marino Ballena, así que los lotes junto a la playa colindan con un área protegida.
